baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ق و ل at words 1 and 4 brackets the imperative ٱدْخُلِ at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: A passive address initiates motion across a boundary and the entrant answers immediately. Speech is therefore both the force at the threshold and the first act from beyond it, while the shift from قِيلَ to قَالَ transfers the speaking position from an unspecified voice to the admitted man.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies both sides of the call-and-response and frames the threshold crossing.
Literal entry into an inside gives the uttered imperative its spatial transition.

changed_reading.before: He is told to enter the Garden and then comments.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a speech-mediated threshold: an address carries him inward, and his answering voice emerges from the new side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ combines entry at words 2-3 with the concealment and protection branches of ج ن ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden is simultaneously a planted enclosure, a hidden interior, and a shield. Entry relocates the man from exposure into protected concealment, but the immediate قَالَ prevents concealment from becoming muteness.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior makes protection a crossed boundary rather than an abstract state.
Concealment supplies the hidden quality of the destination.
The tree-covered garden keeps the ordinary destination image materially present.
The protective shield branch turns hiddenness into refuge rather than erasure.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is only a destination or reward.
changed_reading.after: The Garden reads as a protected hidden interior that receives him without extinguishing his voice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wish turns from the admitted speaker toward قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker's first concern after entry is disclosure to his own collective. Knowledge is an unveiling to a knower, while the saying itself carries sincere concern; admission thus produces outward-facing solicitude rather than private enjoyment.

activation_trace.role: Sincere concern gives the man's utterance an interested, caring orientation toward its object.
The human group and kin branch identifies the wished-for beneficiaries as his own social body.
Disclosure to a knower makes the wish seek changed awareness rather than mere transmission of words.

changed_reading.before: He wishes that his people possessed a fact about his fate.
changed_reading.after: His post-entry speech seeks an unveiling for his own collective, preserving social care across the boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier context makes the قوم heedless, enclosed by blockage, and without sight, while warning is meant to awaken. Against that field, the ج ن ن concealment of the focus ayah reverses the value of hiddenness: the people are hidden from perception, whereas the man is hidden in protection and wishes disclosure for them.

activation_trace.role: Heedlessness as being left outside wakeful attention defines the people's initial epistemic condition.
Heart-sight makes the denied seeing a failure of discernment as well as vision.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the possible passage out of heedlessness.
Protective concealment in the focus creates the positive counterpart to obstructed perception.
Knowledge as disclosure names the reversal the speaker desires for his people.

structural_cues: 36:6 names a قوم as heedless; 36:8-10 then spatialize blockage around them and deny sight.
36:11 narrows effective warning to one who follows remembrance before the town narrative supplies such a responder.
At 36:26 the protected, hidden man wishes disclosure for the still-blocked collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heedlessness, absent sight, awakening warning, and the ج ن ن concealment branch; I infer an inversion between harmful epistemic enclosure and protective enclosure. A live alternative is the simpler reading that the people merely lack news of his reward.

changed_reading.before: His people simply do not possess information that he possesses.
changed_reading.after: His wish seeks a reversal of enclosure: may a people blocked from seeing cross into disclosure, as he has crossed into protective hiddenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The man moves purposefully toward the public conflict, addresses his people, and ends his earthly-facing appeal with فَٱسْمَعُونِ. The focus wish follows, and 36:27 immediately supplies forgiveness and honor as what he wants known. His advocacy therefore continues through entry rather than being replaced by private retrospection.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful motion toward a sought end establishes the man's active approach to his people.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes فَٱسْمَعُونِ a request for changed response, not sound reception alone.
The answering utterance carries the public appeal across the entry threshold.
Covering the fault and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the first content he wants disclosed.
Bestowed honor supplies the second content and shows the outcome he wants his people to recognize.

structural_cues: 36:20-25 sustain one first-person appeal from arrival through belief and the imperative فَٱسْمَعُونِ.
36:26 changes the speaker's location but not his addressee-centered concern.
36:27 is attached by بِمَا and names forgiveness and being made among the honored.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful approach, a demand for understanding, the immediate entry, and the بِمَا clause; I infer that the same advocacy persists across the threshold. The live grammatical alternative is that 36:27 only fills out the object of يَعْلَمُونَ, but even that keeps the wish outward-facing.

changed_reading.before: A private post-entry wish interrupts the man's public speech.
changed_reading.after: The wish is his public appeal continued from the far side: he still wants his people to understand the path whose outcome he now experiences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later signs turn dead earth into living growth, place gardens over bursting springs, and culminate in fruit; the later Garden scene adds protective shade and a word of peace. These sequences make the focus Garden's concealment generative rather than terminal: hidden life emerges as provision, shelter, and speech.

activation_trace.role: Earth revived through rain and vegetation supplies the passage from hidden deathlike stillness to growth.
The tree-covered gardens materially repeat the focus destination within the revived-earth sequence.
Wide splitting and outflow make the enclosed garden a site from which life-bearing water emerges.
Fruit as realized benefit gives the growth sequence a usable outcome.
Shade as shelter and protection confirms the Garden as a guarded interior.
Peace as freedom from harm names the condition reached inside that protection.
An articulated word of peace keeps speech active within the later Garden, echoing the focus response.

structural_cues: 36:33-35 order dead earth, revival, emergence, gardens, flowing water, and fruit as one material mechanism.
36:55-58 order Garden companionship, shade, enjoyment, and a spoken peace.
Both sequences repeat elements already compressed in 36:26: concealment, entry, and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two garden sequences, one ecological and one eschatological; I infer that their shared enclosure-growth-protection pattern retroacts on the focus Garden. A live alternative keeps the agricultural gardens as a separate sign with no material analogy to the man's entry.

changed_reading.before: Protected concealment is a static refuge after the man's ordeal.
changed_reading.after: The entered concealment is also generative: what is hidden can issue in fruit, shelter, peace, and renewed speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first denies destroyed generations a return to their people yet immediately says all will be brought present; later, sleepers are roused, gathered, and made present. The resurrection branch latent in ق و م lets the focus wish point beyond present nonrecognition toward a future collective standing.

activation_trace.role: Standing at resurrection gives the social noun a branch-distant temporal resonance with the later assembly.
Disclosure remains the wished-for event whose timing is revised.
Return to a prior place is explicitly denied at the level of historical return to the living.
Rousing the still from rest reopens motion after the denied historical return.
Gathering dispersed persons restores the collective field addressed by قَوْمِى.
Presence with witnessing gives the gathered collective a setting in which disclosure can no longer remain remote.

structural_cues: 36:31-32 juxtapose no return to former peoples with universal future presence.
36:51-53 repeat the movement more explicitly from graves through rousing to total gathered presence.
The focus wish addresses a collective rather than asking for the man's own further benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied historical return, later rousing, gathering, and presence; I infer a deferred temporal answer to the man's wish. A live alternative is that universal assembly does not entail his particular people understanding the cause of his honor.

changed_reading.before: If only my people knew is an unfulfilled lament fixed at the moment of separation.
changed_reading.after: The wish also opens forward: present knowledge is blocked, but communal standing and unavoidable presence make disclosure temporally deferred rather than simply impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory permits a thing's 'saying' to be its indication and knowledge to arrive through a distinguishing mark. Later, mouths are sealed while hands speak and feet testify. The wish for his people to know therefore need not depend only on preserving his audible voice; disclosure can migrate into embodied signs.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication functioning as its saying opens a channel of disclosure beyond voiced propositions.
A distinguishing sign that guides to its object connects knowledge with readable evidence.
A preventing seal closes the expected oral channel.
Intelligible speech is reassigned from mouths to hands, demonstrating channel migration.
Testimony that declares from knowledge turns the feet into evidence-bearing speakers.

structural_cues: 36:12 has already made deeds and آثار recordable before the town narrative begins.
36:46 says signs repeatedly come to the people while they turn away.
36:65 closes mouths but activates hands and feet as speaking and witnessing subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies indication, marking, a sealed oral channel, and speaking limbs; I infer that disclosure is channel-independent and let that mechanism retroact on قَالَ and يَعْلَمُونَ. A live alternative confines the limb scene to evidence about deeds at judgment, without bearing on the man's wish.

changed_reading.before: His people can know only if his spoken report somehow reaches them.
changed_reading.after: His voice models a wider testimony in which reality itself can become legible and speak even when ordinary mouths are absent or closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing creation formula joins command, saying, and immediate being. Read backward through that speech-act logic, قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ is more than information about permission: the uttered imperative and the achieved crossing become nearly one event. The man's answering wish then contrasts effective admission with creaturely speech whose desired communal result remains pending.

activation_trace.role: The spoken command and spoken response provide the focus pair whose different effects are tested.
Actual passage into an interior is the event immediately attached to the command.
Command as an obligating request supplies the directive component of the final speech-act formula.
Articulated saying is placed directly between command and realized being.
Occurrence and presence supply both the imperative 'be' and its immediate realized result.

structural_cues: 36:26 places passive saying, an imperative of entry, and the entrant's response in immediate sequence.
36:82 places command, saying to a thing, the imperative كُن, and فَيَكُونُ in one conditional sequence.
The focus does not identify the passive speaker, so the mechanism concerns the surah's speech-act pattern rather than speaker identification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two command-saying-event sequences; I infer that the final explicit formula sharpens the earlier passive imperative as event-making. A live alternative treats قِيلَ only as a report of admission whose actual entry occurs independently of the utterance.

changed_reading.before: The man receives an instruction and subsequently carries it out.
changed_reading.after: Within the surah's speech-act logic, the command itself ushers him across; the ayah then juxtaposes effective admission with a compassionate wish awaiting its effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because B009 is a mortuary branch of the ج ن ن family, not the lexical sense of جَنَّة in the focus. It remains anchored to the focus root and is activated by the later grave-and-rousing sequence. Downstream prose should carry it only as a material undertone that overlays, and never replaces, Garden or Paradise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins entry at word 2 to جَنَّة at word 3, whose branch inventory includes both protected enclosure and the covering of the dead.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies movement into the proposed material enclosure.
Covering the dead supplies a branch-distant burial layer beneath the Garden's ordinary sense.
The explicit grave gives the concealment layer a concrete later location.
Rousing a still sleeper turns burial concealment into a transitional rather than terminal state.

changed_reading.before: Entry into the Garden and burial concealment belong to wholly separate frames.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material undertone, the command can momentarily overlay protected Garden entry with being covered in death before awakening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because B021 names an eye structurally standing while sightless and is branch-distant from the social noun قَوْم. It remains rooted in the exact focus root and is matched by the context's denied and threatened sight. Downstream prose should render it as an image for the people's condition, never as a lexical translation of قَوْمِى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَوْمِى at word 6 shares ق و م with the branch image of an intact standing eye whose vision has gone, immediately followed by the wish that they know.

activation_trace.role: The standing but sightless eye supplies a strange embodied image for a socially intact yet undiscerning people.
A distinguishing, guiding mark specifies the perception the image lacks.
Literal eyesight is denied to the blocked group and activates the outlier's loss-of-vision image.
The concrete eye keeps the outlier embodied rather than reducing it to generic ignorance.
Loss of light and sight turns the earlier failure to see into a threatened erasure of visual capacity.

changed_reading.before: قَوْمِى simply identifies the speaker's people as an external social group.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the collective is imaged as a standing eye whose form remains while perception fails, making يَعْلَمُونَ a wish for restored discernment.

strongest_changes: The doubled saying became a threshold mechanism: an address carries the man inward and his voice answers from beyond.
The knowledge wish became a reversal of two concealments, harmful blockage for the people and protective hiddenness for the man.
The adjacent فَٱسْمَعُونِ and 36:27 showed that communal advocacy continues through entry rather than yielding to private reward.
Later gathering and the final command-saying-being formula made the wish temporally open and the entry command event-like.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made this short ayah a hinge between the town's failed hearing and the surah's later ecologies of revival, Garden speech, embodied testimony, collective presence, and creative command. The most distinctive activation was that concealment changed valence without silencing speech.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive speaker of قِيلَ remains unspecified, so the performative model does not identify a speaker.
It remains uncertain whether 36:27 only states the content of the wished-for knowledge or also sharpens the causal force of the wish.
Universal assembly does not by itself guarantee that the man's people receive saving knowledge rather than belated recognition.
The burial and standing-eye outliers are root-branch analogies, not substitute lexical senses.
